subject: Human Body
title: The Limbic System
description: A 60-second lesson on The Limbic System.

hook.text: Fear, joy, anger, and love all come from a ring of structures deep inside your brain: the limbic system.

buildup.text: The amygdala detects threats in milliseconds. It triggers fear before your conscious mind even registers danger.

discovery.text: The hippocampus converts short-term memories into long-term ones. Damage it and you can't form new memories.

twist.text: Emotional memories are stronger because the amygdala stamps them. Trauma feels vivid decades later for this reason.

climax.text: The limbic system runs faster than logic. That's why you react emotionally before you reason through a situation.

punchline.text: You feel before you think. Emotion outruns logic.

quiz.question: What does the hippocampus do?
options: Converts short-term memories to long-term ones
